topic: Alan Shepard golf on the Moon
hook: Your golf game on the Moon really happened.
title: A Man Played Golf on the Moon in 1971
description:
On Apollo 14 in 1971, Alan Shepard attached a golf club head to a tool handle and hit golf balls on the Moon. His stiff spacesuit meant a one-handed swing. Series: If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Space #Apollo14
comment_prompt: Would you play golf up there? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your golf game on the Moon really happened.
scenes.headline: GOLF ON THE MOON

scenes.narration: Alan Shepard did it on Apollo 14.
scenes.headline: ALAN SHEPARD

scenes.narration: He brought a golf club head along.
scenes.headline: A CLUB HEAD

scenes.narration: He clipped it onto a tool handle.
scenes.headline: ON A TOOL HANDLE

scenes.narration: Then he swung at real golf balls.
scenes.headline: REAL GOLF BALLS

scenes.narration: His stiff spacesuit forced a one-handed swing.
scenes.headline: ONE-HANDED SWING

scenes.narration: It was 1971, and the camera caught it.
scenes.headline: CAUGHT ON CAMERA

scenes.narration: Low gravity, no air, nothing to slow it.
scenes.headline: LOW GRAVITY

scenes.narration: That's golf on the Moon, and it happened.
scenes.headline: IT HAPPENED

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: cars left parked up there.
